library(tidyverse)

```{r ompound_data}
perp <- perpetrator(
  "examplinib",
  dose = 450, imaxss = 3530, mw = 492.6, oral = TRUE, fu = 0.023, fa = 0.81,
  ka = 0.00267,
  source = c(dose = "clincial dose", imaxss = "study 001", fu = "study 002",
             rb = "study 003")
)
```

```{r}
cyp_inh <- cyp_inhibitor_data(
  "examplinib",
  ki = c(CYP2C8 =  11, CYP2C9 =  0.6, CYP2C19 = 0.25, CYP3A4 =  12.5),
  source = "study 001"
)
```

```{r}
property_table(perp)
conc_table(perp)

basic_cyp_inhibition_risk_table(perp, cyp_inh)
```
